data.name: TeaKnights
data.detailed_description:
TeaKnights is a fully on-rails musical shooter set on SCEPTRE-011, a space colony divided into seven tea-powered biodome kingdoms.

When one of the seven TeaKnights mysteriously disappears, an emergency selection is called for the Forest Dome. The chosen candidate is Camellia Jetsworth, a studious young apprentice who knows the knights’ creed by heart but has never proven herself on the battlefield.

To earn her title, Camellia must clear the Grading, a trial of valor that sends her across colorful low-poly 3D stages filled with enemies, hazards, bosses, and fellow knight encounters.

Armed with her TeaSetter REGALIA, a tea-powered weapon that can fire as a gun and transform into a vapor-sword, Camellia must shoot, dodge, slash, and build chain combos while the game’s dynamic soundtrack reacts to her performance.

Explore the overworld between missions, discover the distinct tea cultures of the biodome kingdoms, customize Camellia with different outfits, and uncover the mystery behind the missing seventh knight.

Features

  • Fully on-rails musical shooter action

  • Fast arcade stages built around aiming, dodging, shooting, and hazards

  • TeaSetter REGALIAS: tea-powered guns that transform into vapor-swords

  • Chain-based combo system connected to a dynamic soundtrack

  • Boss battles and real-time encounters with other TeaKnights

  • Explorable overworld set across seven tea-themed biodome kingdoms

  • Customizable outfits for Camellia

  • Low-poly 3D visuals inspired by Y2K-era games, anime, and digital culture

data.short_description: TeaKnights is a Y2K-inspired musical rail shooter set across seven tea-powered biodomes. As apprentice Camellia Jetsworth, blast enemies with TeaSetter REGALIAS, build chain combos to drive the dynamic soundtrack, face bosses, aid fellow knights, explore the overworld, and customize your look.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K (4 * 3500) or AMD Ryzen 3 2200G (4 * 3500)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce 9600 GT or AMD HD 3870 512MB or higher
  • Sound Card: DirectX®-compatible
